title: A first-owner invitee finished setting up their identity
description: Payload of FirstOwnerInviteeSetupCompleted (P4 design §11, P4d). platform-identity publishes it CRITICAL, PLATFORM-scoped, through its outbox when the invitee's credential setup commits; platform-tenant resends the first-owner links of that identity's pending invitations. x-brix-classification marks each field (root BRX-RS-SECURITY-008).
